# telnyx_texml_secret (Resource)

A TeXML secret: a named value that TeXML Mustache templates reference as a dynamic parameter, so the value never appears in the template or in logs. The Telnyx API can create or replace a secret but cannot read or delete it: Terraform cannot detect changes made outside it, the secret cannot be imported, and destroy leaves it in your account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A secret that TeXML templates use as {{crm_api_key}}. The value is
# write-only: bump value_wo_version to send a new value.
variable "crm_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "telnyx_texml_secret" "crm" {
  name             = "crm_api_key"
  value_wo         = var.crm_api_key
  value_wo_version = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `name` (String) Name used as a reference for the secret, if the name already exists within the account its value will be replaced
- `value_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Secret value which will be used when rendering the TeXML template Write-only: never stored in state. Change `value_wo_version` to send a new value.

### Optional

- `value_wo_version` (Number) Change this number to send `value_wo` again; Terraform cannot detect a change to a value it does not store.
